# hiok_communication_domain (Resource)

A sending domain. Managed domains publish their own DNS and verify immediately.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Label for a managed domain, or the full name for your own.
- `service_id` (String) Owning communication service.

### Optional

- `domain_kind` (String) managed or custom.
- `inbound_enabled` (Boolean) Accept incoming mail for this domain.
- `relay_host` (String)
- `relay_password` (String, Sensitive)
- `relay_port` (Number)
- `relay_username` (String)
- `send_mode` (String) hiok_mta to send through Hiok, relay to use your own provider.

### Read-Only

- `dkim_verified` (Boolean)
- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified domain that was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `spf_verified` (Boolean)
- `status` (String) verified once its DNS proofs are in place.
